name: Utah Megacomp 2023
information: * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * No outside food and drink is allowed in the venue. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with much of the information you need. * All first-time competitors should be present for the competitor tutorial at 9:00 AM.
